exams.name: PSAT 10
exams.blurb: Spring-administered digital practice test for tenth graders that uses the same content and scale as the SAT but confers no scholarship entry.

exams.name: PSAT 8/9
exams.blurb: Entry point of the digital SAT Suite for eighth and ninth graders, establishing a baseline in reading, writing and mathematics.

exams.name: PSAT/NMSQT
exams.blurb: Digital practice SAT taken in October that also serves as the qualifying test for National Merit Scholarship Program recognition.

exams.name: SAT
exams.blurb: Adaptive digital college admissions test scored 400 to 1600 across Reading and Writing and Math sections, taken in about two hours.

exams.name: SAT Subject Tests
exams.blurb: Hour-long single-subject admissions tests that College Board discontinued in January 2021; no scores are issued or accepted today.

exams.name: ACT
exams.blurb: National college admissions test scored 1 to 36 with English, math and reading sections plus optional science and writing components.

exams.name: PreACT
exams.blurb: Practice assessment for tenth graders that predicts a future ACT score using shorter English, math, reading and science sections.

exams.name: PreACT 8/9
exams.blurb: Early-high-school assessment for eighth and ninth graders that reports on the ACT score scale to guide course planning and readiness.

exams.name: Classic Learning Test
exams.blurb: Online college admissions test built around classical texts, accepted by more than 250 US colleges and by several states for scholarships.

exams.name: CLT10
exams.blurb: Practice and scholarship-qualifying Classic Learning Test for ninth and tenth graders preparing for the full CLT admissions exam.

exams.name: CLT8
exams.blurb: Diagnostic Classic Learning Test for students in grades seven and eight that benchmarks verbal reasoning, grammar and quantitative skills.

exams.name: GED Test
exams.blurb: Four-subject high school equivalency exam in reasoning through language arts, mathematics, science and social studies used in most states.

exams.name: HiSET Exam
exams.blurb: Five-subtest high school equivalency exam offered on computer and paper in many states as an alternative to the GED test.

exams.name: National External Diploma Program
exams.blurb: Portfolio and competency-based route to a high school diploma for adults, assessed through applied performance tasks rather than a timed test.

exams.name: TASC Test
exams.blurb: High school equivalency exam discontinued in 2022; former TASC states such as New York and Indiana now use the GED or HiSET instead.
